description: This Java class 'DatatableCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer' is responsible for deserializing, validating, and processing JSON payloads related to DataTable commands such as create and update operations within the Fineract project. It handles JSON parsing, parameter validation, and mapping of API data types to JDBC types for data table management.

classes.name: DatatableCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: Component class for deserializing and validating JSON data for DataTable commands such as creation and update within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for creating a new DataTable, including schema validation, parameter parsing, and data integrity checks.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for updating an existing DataTable, ensuring proper format, parameter correctness, and logical consistency.

methods.name: mapApiTypeToJdbcType
methods.description: Maps API-specified data types to corresponding JDBC types, with an option to throw exceptions on unsupported types.
